_comment: Edit 'systems' to point at the export root of each company system. Paths may be absolute or relative to this file. format: 'abapgit' (default, one folder per package with abapGit-named files) or 'chunks' (one folder per package holding chained <prefix>_<NNNN>.abapchunk text files; run /unchunk first). object_marker: optional regex with named groups type (optional) and name that identifies the line starting each object inside a chunk; leave null to auto-detect.
